summary.overall: Sides are consistent (+z is LH/driver), and the big layout facts match: intake toward the firewall, exhaust/cat toward the radiator, battery/airbox/PCM/CJB/trans on the driver side, belts and accessories on the passenger side, tank ahead of the rear axle, and blower/cabin filter on the passenger side. The real errors are the three exhaust cylinders left with rot [0,0,0], which makes them vertical and puts them through the floor and cabin, and a short roof that turns the wagon into a hatch profile. After that, fix the cooling-fan orientation, the RH halfshaft running through the block, the belt-end accessories overlapping the belt and exhaust, the windshield being a solid slab, and slightly oversized wheels.

lh_evidence: Every LH/driver-named part is at +z: wheel-fl/rl +2.98, strut-fl +2.55, fender-l/door-fl/door-rl +3.4, cv-axle-l +2.4, taillamp-l and headlamp-l +z, driver seat +1.6, steering column and ignition switch +1.55. Every RH part mirrors to -z. Parts placed from the real-car facts agree: battery, airbox, PCM, CJB, transaxle, clutch and master cylinder are at +z; timing belt, serpentine belt, alternator, PS pump, A/C compressor, degas bottle, blower and cabin filter are at -z. The sides are consistent throughout.

findings.problem: The cylinder has rot [0,0,0], so it stands vertical. At 7.2 long around y=0.5 it spans y -3.1 to 4.1, going through the floor and up through the cabin. The vertical rods in the side render match this.
findings.why: The mid pipe runs level along the underbody (fore/aft) at about y 0.5. Set rot to [0,0,1.5708] so it spans x -5.1 to 2.1.

findings.problem: Also rot [0,0,0], so it is vertical: 4.6 long around y=0.7 gives y -1.6 to 3.0, through the ground and up into the engine.
findings.why: The front pipe runs back from the cat under the floor. Set rot to [0,0,1.5708] so it spans x 2.3 to 6.9 and meets the mid pipe.

findings.problem: rot [0,0,0] makes it a 3-tall vertical drum with its bottom at y -0.8, below the ground.
findings.why: The Focus rear muffler hangs level under the rear floor behind the axle. Set rot to [0,0,1.5708] (along x) or [1.5708,0,0] (across the car, which is closer to the real Mk1 box) and keep y at 0.7.

findings.problem: The roof ends at x -5.95, but the vertical liftgate is at x -8.9, which leaves a 3-unit hole over the cargo area. That is a hatchback/sedan profile, not a wagon.
findings.why: The Focus wagon roof runs flat almost to the liftgate. Also move pos to [-3.4,5.62,0] so it spans x -8.85 to 2.05.

findings.problem: The cylinder has no rot, so the fan disc lies flat with its radius 0.75 along x (7.05 to 8.55). It cuts through the radiator (8.3) and the exhaust manifold (up to 7.3).
findings.why: The fan shroud stands behind the radiator, facing fore/aft. Set rot to [0,0,1.5708] and keep pos x at about 7.9.

findings.problem: The size is [2.2,3,5.8], a block 2.2 thick by 3 tall, not a pane. The render looks thin, so the shell may override this, but the data is wrong.
findings.why: The glass is about 5 mm thick. With rot z -0.55, a long x and thin y gives the correct raked pane.

findings.problem: At x 5.6, y 1.44 it runs from z -2.7 to 0.7, straight through the engine block (x 4.77 to 6.67, y 0.8 to 3.2).
findings.why: The RH halfshaft and intermediate shaft run behind the block and oil pan to the passenger hub. Alternatively, move the whole engine/trans group about 0.5 forward.

findings.problem: At z -1.5 it sits inside the timing-belt plane (z -1.65 to -1.35, x 4.6 to 6.8).
findings.why: The Zetec alternator is on the front face of the passenger end, inboard of the belt plane.

findings.problem: It overlaps the exhaust manifold/cat box (x 6.5 to 7.3, y 1.3 to 2.7, z -1.1 to 1.1) and the O2 sensor.
findings.why: The compressor bolts low on the front of the block at the passenger end, below and outboard of the cat.

findings.problem: The hub (z 2.75) is outboard of the rotor (z 2.55), which reverses the stack. Its ex (5) also equals cv-axle-l's ex (5), so the two collide when exploded.
findings.why: The order from inboard is CV axle, then knuckle/bearing, then hub flange, then rotor, then wheel. Also set cv-axle-l ex to [0,0,4] so explodes step 4, 5, 6, 7.

findings.problem: Radius 1.44 is about a 0.70 m tire diameter at the model scale (about 4.1 u/m, from wheelbase 10.59 = 2.6 m). The rear wheels use 1.39, so front and rear differ.
findings.why: The 195/60R15 or 205/50R16 tire is about 0.61 to 0.63 m in diameter, the same front and rear. Apply the same fix to wheel-fr/rl/rr and set y to 1.26.

findings.problem: The top of the tilted column ends at about x 1.14, y 4.06, which puts the steering wheel over the middle of the driver seat (seat x 0.4 to 2.2).
findings.why: The wheel sits about 0.5 m ahead of the seatback and just behind the dash (dash x 2.5 to 4.1). Move ignition-sw and key with it to about x 2.9.

findings.problem: Radius 0.45 is about a 22 cm diameter. It also overlaps the airbox (x 5.2 to 6.6, z 0.95 to 2.25).
findings.why: The Zetec thermostat housing is a small outlet of about 8 to 10 cm on the LH end of the head. Suggested pos is [5.0,2.9,1.35].

findings.problem: Radius 0.4 is about a 20 cm diameter, and it sits half inside the airbox.
findings.why: The MAF is an inline sensor of about 8 cm in the duct between the airbox outlet and the throttle body. Suggested pos is [4.8,3.6,1.55].

findings.problem: At x 1.4 it is level with the middle of the front seats.
findings.why: The Focus shifter is on the console just ahead of the front seat cushions.

findings.problem: At x 7.68 to 8.38 the lamp is about 1.3 behind the bumper face and overlaps the radiator's z edge. The same applies to headlamp-r.
findings.why: The Mk1 headlamps sweep back from the bumper top and sit in front of the core support.

findings.problem: It sits low (y 2.2 to 3.8). The same applies to taillamp-r.
findings.why: The Focus wagon tail lamps are tall vertical units in the D-pillars, above the bumper, up to the belt/roof area.

findings.problem: Radius 0.28 is about a 14 cm diameter.
findings.why: The inline fuel filter is about 6 cm in diameter.

findings.problem: The top at y 3.65 (about 0.89 m) is low for a seatback. The same applies to seat-fr and seat-rear.
findings.why: The front seatback top is about 1.15 to 1.2 m off the ground. Raise pos y to 2.85.

findings.problem: The name contains leftover debug text: "MERCON V? No:".
findings.why: MTX-75 uses WSD-M2C200-C (XT-M5-QS), and 4F27E uses MERCON V. Rename it cleanly.
